SELECT Top 1 IsNull(am.AccessRight,'') as AccessRight, 1 as Gubun FROM DP_ACC_User au WITH(NOLOCK) left outer join DP_MDM_List am WITH(NOLOCK) ON au.CompanyID = am.CompanyID AND au.UserID = am.UserID WHERE au.CompanyID = '{0}' And au.LoginID = '{1}' AND au.ActiveUser=1 UNION SELECT IsNull(AccessRight,'') as AccessRight, 2 as Gubun FROM DP_MDM_Env WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' order by Gubun

SELECT UserRoles.CompanyID, UserRoles.RoleID, Roles.RoleCode, Roles.RoleName, Users.UserID, Users.NameKo,Users.NameEn,Users.NameJa, Users.NameFr,Users.NameZhCn,Users.NameZhTw, Users.ManyName, Users.MobilePhone, Users.MailID , Users.MailDomain FROM DP_EIP_UserRole AS UserRoles WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN DP_ACC_Dept AS Depts WITH(NOLOCK) ON UserRoles.CompanyID = Depts.CompanyID AND UserRoles.UserID = Depts.DeptID INNER JOIN DP_EIP_Role AS Roles WITH(NOLOCK) ON UserRoles.RoleID = Roles.RoleID AND UserRoles.CompanyID = Roles.CompanyID INNER JOIN VW_UserInfo as Users WITH(NOLOCK) ON UserRoles.UserID = Users.DeptID AND UserRoles.CompanyID = Users.CompanyID WHERE UserRoles.CompanyID = {0} AND UserRoles.Types = 'GG' AND Depts.ActiveDept = 1 AND Users.ActiveCompany = 1 AND Users.ActiveUser = 1 AND UserRoles.RoleID in (SELECT RoleID FROM DP_EIP_Role Where CompanyID = {0} AND RoleCode='mdm') UNION SELECT UserRoles.CompanyID, UserRoles.RoleID, Roles.RoleCode, Roles.RoleName, Users.UserID, Users.NameKo,Users.NameEn,Users.NameJa, Users.NameFr,Users.NameZhCn,Users.NameZhTw, Users.ManyName, Users.MobilePhone, Users.MailID , Users.MailDomain FROM DP_EIP_UserRole AS UserRoles WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN VW_UserInfo AS Users WITH(NOLOCK) ON UserRoles.CompanyID = Users.CompanyID AND UserRoles.UserID = Users.UserID INNER JOIN DP_EIP_Role AS Roles WITH(NOLOCK) ON UserRoles.RoleID = Roles.RoleID AND UserRoles.CompanyID = Roles.CompanyID WHERE UserRoles.CompanyID = {0} AND UserRoles.Types = 'GM' AND Users.ActiveCompany = 1 AND Users.ActiveUser = 1 AND Users.BaseDept = 1 AND UserRoles.RoleID in (SELECT RoleID FROM DP_EIP_Role WITH(NOLOCK) Where CompanyID = {0} AND RoleCode='mdm')
